newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Zag EPS estimate lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Zag EPS estimate lowered.

text.p: Lehman Brothers revised downwards its earnings estimates for Israel's Zag Industries, saying prices in dollar terms for its products were under pressure in Germany and France.
"This will put some pressure on gross margins and trim roughly $0.02 from the first quarter of 1997," analyst Harriet Baldwin said in a report.
She revised her first-quarter earnings per share estimate to $0.21 from $0.23 and her 1997 estimate to $1.13 from $1.17.
Lehman maintained its 1-buy recommendation for the company as well as its 12-16 month price target of $26. It currently trades at $13-1/2.
"Zag's growth is not only intact, it is running ahead of expectations. We believe some currency concerns are already reflected in the shares," the report said.
Zag manufactures consumer products made primarily of molded plastic.
